ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all shareholders, directors, administrators and UBOs against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Egypt's domestic terrorist-entity designations issued through the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU), as required by AML Law No. 80 of 2002 (Articles 3, 4, 5, 14) and CBE/FRA circulars. Politically Exposed Persons are defined per Executive Regulations Decree No. 95 of 2003 (as amended); foreign PEPs, their family members and close associates must receive enhanced due diligence. Screening results must be documented and retained in the company's AML compliance file for at least five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI Electronic One-Stop Shop 'Invest in Egypt' portal (https://www.investinegypt.gov.eg) and the Egyptian Commercial Registry Authority interface
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under Law No. 159 of 1981 and its Executive Regulations, the LLC name must be stated in Arabic script and may be supplemented by a Latin transliteration. The name must not be misleading, must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name, must include the legal form marker 'LLC' (Arabic: شركة ذات مسؤولية محدودة / ش.م.م), and may include the transliterated trade name of the foreign shareholder, subject to GAFI clearance.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank / بنك (requires prior Central Bank of Egypt licensing approval)
Insurance / تأمين (requires prior FRA licensing approval)
National / وطنية, قومية (requires prior ministerial approval)
Presidential / رئيس, رئاسي (reserved; requires high-level approval)
Military / عسكري, جيش, شرطة (prohibited without Ministry of Defense approval)
Islamic / إسلامي or religious references (requires approval; sensitive to public order)
Central / مركزي (requires approval where it implies public authority)
Corrupt, obscene or public-order-contravening expressions (prohibited absolutely)
Equivalent Latin tokens: Bank, Insurance, National, Central, Government, Ministry, International
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation is valid for 30 days and may be renewed once for an additional 30 days upon payment of the applicable fee. If the name is rejected, the applicant may file a written grievance with GAFI's Internal Grievance Committee within 30 working days of the rejection notice under Article 52 of Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; if the grievance is denied or unanswered, the applicant may appeal to the Administrative Judiciary (Egyptian State Council) within 60 days of the express or implied refusal, pursuant to State Council Law No. 106 of 1964.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is not permissible as the sole registered address. Law No. 159 of 1981 (Article 6) requires the LLC to maintain a physical registered office in Egypt for service of process and statutory notices. Additionally, the Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) requires licensees engaged in marine insurance surveying (auxiliary insurance activity) to maintain operational physical premises, records, and professional liability cover; co-working or business-center addresses may be accepted for initial incorporation but do not satisfy FRA substance requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (65-80%) for FRA-regulated marine insurance surveyor licensees within the first twelve months of operation due to insurance-sector supervision protocols; moderate (20-30%) for GAFI/commercial registry unannounced verification visits; the registered office must maintain the statutory records (articles of association, shareholder register, UBO register, board minutes) available for immediate inspection.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egyptian Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 as amended by Law No. 4 of 2018; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations, particularly the provisions governing limited liability company formation under Articles 20-34; supporting Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Companies Registration and Commercial Registry One-Stop Shop
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Arabic-language Memorandum and Articles of Association together with the incorporation application form and shareholders' subscription list
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an Egyptian LLC. The stated capital must be fully subscribed and adequate to support the marine surveying activities. Cash contributions are deposited in an Egyptian bank, and the resulting bank certificate is filed with GAFI. Escrow requirements apply only where investment incentives are claimed under the Investment Law, not for standard LLC incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that all shareholders accept subscription to the LLC quotas totaling the capital specified in the Articles of Association, and that such quotas be allocated as described in incorporation documents. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office at the address listed in the Articles is adopted as the Egypt head office, and the proposed directors are elected. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Managing Director and the Compliance Officer are appointed, with authority to execute all registration documents with GAFI, open bank accounts, appoint the auditor, and obtain marine survey licensing, subject to applicable law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Incorporation Name Reservation and Scope Review
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Investor Services Center or online GAFI portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name clearance request for the proposed Arabic and English company name together with the intended business purpose referencing marine claims survey services under ISIC 5222. GAFI checks the proposed name against the Commercial Registry database. After clearance, the approved name is reserved for the statutory window. The scope description must clarify that the LLC will perform vessel hull and cargo damage inspection for insurance claims, not vessel operation.
required_dossiers: Concise business plan and scope description
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Amend the proposed trade name and resubmit; if the refusal is based on similarity to a dormant registration, an objection may be filed with GAFI's legal department.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Notarize the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian public notary and certified Arabic translation office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Arabic Memorandum and Articles of Association containing the company name, object clauses, capital and quota allocation, head office address, management structure, and dispute resolution provisions. Each shareholder's signature on the quota subscription must be personally authenticated before a notary. For non-resident shareholders, signatures are legalized through the Egyptian consulate or an authorized signatory holding a notarized power of attorney.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Notarized power of attorney, if any
Valid passports or national IDs of shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any notarial discrepancies by re-executing the affected signature pages and re-notarizing the corrected pages before resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Registration and Commercial Registry Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop - Companies Registration Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized incorporation documents and complete the GAFI checklist to obtain the commercial registration extract, company establishment certificate, and preliminary tax stamp. GAFI performs a legal review for standard LLC formations and issues the registration extract once the state filing fees are settled. After registration, GAFI arranges referral for publication in the Official Gazette and issuance of the initial business number.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Bank certificate of capital deposit or paid-in declaration
Police good conduct or good repute records for directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the file is queried, provide the requested clarifications or missing documents within 15 days through GAFI's electronic follow-up system. A formal written refusal may be appealed before the competent administrative court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), National Organization for Social Insurance, and the Labor Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Use the commercial registration extract to register the LLC with the ETA for corporate income tax, value added tax, and payroll levies. Register directors and employees with the social insurance authority and file the workplace labor list. Obtain the ETA tax card and social insurance certificate necessary for bank account opening and sector licensing.
required_dossiers: Board resolution appointing the legal representative
Identification documents of directors and employees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify inconsistencies between the tax address and the commercial registration address and respond to ETA clarification requests within the statutory notice period by submitting a reconciled address proof and lease.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open Bank Operating Account and Verify Paid-Up Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank operating in Egypt and Central Bank of Egypt compliance desks
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the notarized incorporation documents, tax card, and commercial registration to open a corporate bank account. The bank performs KYC on all shareholders and signatories and may require the paid-up capital deposit certificate. For marine insurance survey income, the account is configured to receive underwriter wire transfers and Wise payments under the low-risk AML classification.
required_dossiers: Passports or IDs of signatories and beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If enhanced due diligence is requested, furnish a board resolution and updated beneficial ownership declaration. The bank may issue the account with a limited transaction cap while final corporate records are being filed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Official Gazette Publication and Municipal Operating Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Official Gazette and the local municipal licensing unit under the Ministry of Trade and Industry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Arrange insertion of the formation notice and subscribed capital in the Official Gazette as required by law. Obtain the municipal operation clearance for the registered office and the initial civil defense certificate. These clearances are prerequisites for the sector-specific marine survey licensing before any client-facing surveying activity begins.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If municipal clearance is delayed, obtain an interim certificate from GAFI and cure any zoning or structural compliance notes submitted by the contracting office.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Egyptian Authority for Maritime Safety (EAMS) under the Ministry of Transportation, in coordination with GAFI and the Marine Transport Sector
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Marine Surveyor Operating License and Certificate of Competency for Vessel Hull and Cargo Marine Claims Survey

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B registration requiring a simplified environmental registration; the activity is limited to office-based marine claims inspection with incidental vessel access and presents no industrial manufacturing processes requiring a full EIA report.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Law No. 48 of 1982 on drainage and effluent discharge to public systems; no significant volatile organic compound emissions from the surveying office; all oil-contaminated materials and marine debris removed through licensed waste carriers subject to EEAA Hazardous Waste Management Decree No. 361 of 2015, and onboard discharges governed by MARPOL standards while conducting vessel surveys.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Civil Defense Authority after inspection of the surveying office and records storage room; structural load inspection certificate for the office if record archiving exceeds standard floor loading; and an occupational safety and health clearance from the Ministry of Manpower for field surveyors and office staff.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance; official electronic portal: www.eta.gov.eg. Investor-facing incorporation and registration coordination is also provided by the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Egyptian LLC first obtains its statutory incorporation certificate from GAFI, registers in the Commercial Registry, and obtains any sectoral license (for marine surveying, the approval of the Financial Regulatory Authority / Insurance Oversight authorities). The LLC then files ETA Taxpayer Registration Form requesting the Tax Identification Number (TIN), supported by the incorporation deed, commercial registration extract, management passports, board resolutions, head-office address proof, and the maritime insurance surveying license. The ETA issues a single TIN; VAT registration is effected through the same ETA registration process if the annual taxable turnover equals or exceeds the statutory threshold or the LLC wishes to register voluntarily.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. An Egyptian LLC is a juridical person and is treated as a separate taxable entity under Egypt's Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005 and the unified tax procedure framework. Resident LLCs are taxed on worldwide income; non-resident taxpayers are taxed on Egypt-source income. Egypt does not recognise pass-through or tax-transparent treatment for LLCs.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egyptian tax law has no US-style check-the-box or pass-through election. An LLC is compulsorily taxed as an entity-level corporation. Limited statutory elections exist only in specific circumstances, such as applying for tax group treatment among qualifying resident corporations, or for non-resident branches to be taxed on a deemed-profit basis. No hybrid mismatch election is available under Egyptian domestic law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Egypt's Value Added Tax Law No. 67 of 2016, as amended, which replaced the prior sales tax regime.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 in annual taxable turnover from supplies of goods and services. Importers and providers of certain taxable services may have separate registration requirements; foreign persons making taxable supplies through Egyptian nexus must register with the ETA even if the turnover threshold is not met.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The ETA mandates a centralised electronic invoicing and electronic receipts clearance system. Registered taxpayers subject to implementation phases must integrate their accounting/ERP systems with ETA-approved APIs or certified fiscal devices, submit invoice and receipt data in structured JSON/XML in near-real time, receive a unique electronic validation code and QR stamp, and issue no valid invoice before fiscal clearance. Non-compliance results in rejection of invoices for input VAT recovery and administrative penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% VAT rate applies to goods physically exported from Egypt under a customs export declaration; to international transport services; and to services directly connected with exported goods, or services rendered and wholly consumed outside Egypt for non-resident recipients. For a marine insurance surveyor, zero-rating may be claimed when the inspection/survey service is supplied to a non-resident underwriter, insurer or cargo owner and the service is either performed wholly outside Egypt or is directly connected with cargo being exported from Egypt. The taxpayer must maintain documentary proof of the foreign recipient, foreign-currency payment, and the actual export/survey transaction.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration / Export Manifest bearing Egyptian customs export clearance stamps
Bill of Lading (or Air Waybill where applicable) evidencing departure of goods from Egypt
Inward Remittance Certificate from a bank in Egypt showing receipt of foreign currency proceeds
Commercial export invoice issued in foreign currency
Marine survey report and service contract identifying the non-resident underwriter or principal
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA audits export zero-rating claims by matching e-invoice data with customs export records, bill-of-lading details, and inward remittance certificates. If the export documents are incomplete, false, or the foreign-currency proceeds are not repatriated within the applicable deadline, the supply is reclassified as taxable at 14% VAT. Retrospective assessments may be raised for up to five years, accompanied by late-payment delay tax, monetary fines, and criminal penalties for tax evasion under VAT Law No. 67 of 2016. Fraudulent zero-rating claims or forged export documents may result in imprisonment, fines equal to the tax evaded, and personal liability of company directors and signatories.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), operating under Banking and Central Bank Law No. 194 of 2020; competent AML/CFT authority is the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU). Insurance-sector licensing is separately administered by the Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA), not the CBE.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt adheres to IMF Article VIII current-account convertibility; since the CBE's unified floating exchange rate regime (March 6, 2024), trade in goods, services, insurance premiums, and claim settlements are freely transferable through licensed banks at the interbank market rate. Capital-account transactions (equity injection, shareholder loans, capital repatriation) are permitted under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 but require GAFI registration, CBE-form declaration, and source-of-funds documentation. Profit and remittance flows are not subject to prior CBE approval, yet operational delays may arise during episodic USD liquidity tightness. Cross-border marine survey fees are current-account invisibles and are remittable without pre-authorization.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under CBE foreign-exchange regulations, marine surveyors (services exporters) must repatriate 100% of foreign-currency receivables to a licensed Egyptian bank within 180 days of invoice maturity; no mandatory conversion into EGP exists after the 2024 float, but repatriated funds must be credited to a domestic FX account and can be freely sold at the interbank (market) rate. Non-compliance triggers CBE penalty circulars and bank review of the client's credit facilities.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational EGP + USD Foreign Currency Account / Capital Deposit Bridge Account
Operational EGP + USD Account / Capital Escrow Account
Operational EGP + USD Account / Statutory License Guarantee Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: QNB ALAHLI (Qatar National Bank Al Ahli)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD/EGP Account with Global Trade & Receivables Finance (MT103/LC rails)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility: CBE does not license offshore electronic money institutions or digital EMIs (Wise, Revolut, Payoneer) to maintain EGP IBANs or execute CBE-supervised FX transactions. Such platforms may function only as an upstream payout channel to an Egyptian licensed bank; they cannot serve as the primary treasury, clearing, or custody account for the Egyptian LLC.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory physical attendance. CBE AML/CFT rules require at least one director, the authorized signatory, and the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) to attend an in-branch client-identification interview; remote video opening is not accepted for foreign-owned LLCs. Non-resident directors may delegate through a notarized, apostilled Power of Attorney naming an Egyptian general manager, but the branch interview, certified-passport verification, and biometric capture remain compulsory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO chain opacity with UAE or GCC natural persons holding the Egyptian LLC
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified incorporation certificate and memorandum, notarized shareholders register, group organizational chart, UBO declaration (natural persons with >=25% ownership), valid passport copies, bank reference letter, 3-year audited financial statements of the parent, and a negative-news/sanctions screening report issued by a reputed due-diligence provider.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital wire arriving from a third country without a clear commercial narrative
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board minutes resolving the equity injection, GAFI investment file, Egyptian commercial registry (CR) extract, tax card, VAT certificate, wire purpose code 'Direct Investment – Equity Capital' (BPM6 F111), and a source-of-funds trail (bank statements and remitter financial statements).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Misclassification of marine surveying as insurance underwriting, triggering unwarranted insurance-license scrutiny
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial registry scope limited to ISIC 5222 (vessel hull and cargo damage claims inspection/surveying), FRA written confirmation that surveyors/claims inspectors are not regulated as insurers, and an Egyptian legal opinion confirming exemption from CBE/FRA solvency and licensing requirements.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: SWIFT MT103 from the parent/UBO bank to the LLC's USD account at an Egyptian licensed bank; bank must submit the CBE BOP statistical form on the same business day using purpose code for direct investment equity (BPM6 F111). Accompanying documentation: GAFI investment certificate, certified articles of association, shareholder resolution, and POA for the executing signatory. The receiving bank may convert funds to EGP at the interbank rate upon client instruction; no CBE prior approval is needed for the remittance itself.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For service fees, reinsurance premiums, and international claims settlements: SWIFT MT103 via CBE straight-through-processing with referenced underlying invoice and FX ticket executed at the interbank market rate; commercial documentary collection is acceptable as an alternative. For physical equipment or vessel-spare purchases: Commercial Letter of Credit (UCP600) or documentary collection; the 2022 mandatory import LC requirement was fully lifted in 2024, so T/T MT103 is again permitted for non-restricted goods.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore USD/EGP plain-vanilla FX forward (must evidence genuine underlying trade or service exposure; tenor typically 7–365 days)
CBE-approved USD/EGP FX swap for cash-flow matching of USD survey-fee receipts against EGP operating costs
Cross-currency interest rate swap (USD/EGP) executed through a licensed bank for capital-account exposure hedging
Offshore EGP non-deliverable forward (NDF) with a licensed international bank, conditional on the existence of an underlying Egyptian-pound exposure and with strictly offshore USD settlement

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements, auditor's report, and ordinary general assembly approval record
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Companies Registration Directorate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the end of the fiscal year; for a calendar-year LLC, no later than 30 June of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fines under Companies Law No. 159/1981; failure to file for two consecutive fiscal years may trigger GAFI administrative strike-off or compulsory winding-up proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return with audited financial statements attached
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the end of the fiscal year; for a calendar-year taxpayer, by 30 April of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory monthly late-filing penalty on tax due (minimum fine applies), default interest, suspension of tax clearance certificate, enforced collection measures, and criminal referral for repeated intentional non-filing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO register confirmation and beneficial-ownership update notification
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI and competent authorities under Egyptian beneficial-ownership rules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after a shareholding transfer or beneficial-ownership change; if there is no change, the updated register must be confirmed at latest with the annual GAFI accounts filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines for inaccurate or incomplete UBO data; non-updated beneficial-ownership records may block regulatory filings and expose managers to personal liability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory register audit certificate covering members register, managers register, minute book, and UBO register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: LLC management and external statutory auditor; certificate retained in the corporate records and produced to GAFI, ETA, or courts on demand
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than the date of filing the annual audited financial statements with GAFI; within 6 months of fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Uncertified or defective statutory registers attract officer penalties, loss of good-standing evidence, and weakened legal position in tax or commercial litigation; persistent failure supports GAFI enforcement action.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of marine claims surveyor registration / insurance sector license
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) - Non-Banking Financial Markets, Insurance Sector
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary date stated in the FRA registration certificate, and no later than 31 December of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Expired registration suspends the right to issue marine claims survey reports; continued operations after expiry expose the LLC and individual surveyors to administrative fines and criminal liability for unlicensed insurance-related activity.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory annual independent audit for all Egyptian LLCs; no turnover or balance-sheet exemption applies under Companies Law No. 159/1981. Audited financial statements and the auditor's report must be attached to the annual corporate income tax return and filed with GAFI.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), substantially aligned with IFRS for statutory entity-level financial reporting; financial statements are prepared and presented in Egyptian pounds.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Egyptian Companies Law requires every LLC to maintain an ultimate beneficial ownership register and to update it within 30 days of any shareholding transfer or beneficial-ownership change. No standalone UBO annual return is required where no change has occurred, but the register must be confirmed and made available for inspection during the annual statutory register audit and with the annual GAFI accounts filing.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Members' Meetings and Managerial Resolutions

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 22.5% on taxable profits of juridical persons for tax periods commencing on or after 1 January 2020 (Article 45, Income Tax Law No. 91/2005 as amended).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No blanket tax holiday applies to a standard EG LLC. Law No. 72/2017 (Investment Law) grants deductible investment incentives of up to 50% of invested capital for qualified Zone A projects and 30% for Zone B projects; a special 20% CIT rate applies to authorized activities within Special Economic Zones such as the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE), with potential SEZ exemption periods under Special Economic Zones Law No. 83/2002; marine surveying services otherwise bear the standard 22.5% rate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Egyptian corporate income tax return Form No. 12 (Self-Assessment Corporate Tax Return); e-filed via the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) unified tax portal (portal.eta.gov.eg / e-Tax services), due within 4 months after the close of the tax year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (Form 12) with quarterly advance income tax payments during the tax year and an annual compliance declaration; quarterly advance installments are reconciled on the annual return.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filed on or before 30 April for a company with a 31 December year-end; generally within 4 months of the fiscal year-end date used in the commercial register. Any taxes shown payable are due on the filing date; the return must be filed even if no tax is payable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification: unified tax number, commercial registration number, tax card and name/address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert Egyptian branch commercial registration number and ETA unified tax number in the name and address; foreign parent details in the related-party annex.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax year (commencement and year-end dates) and accounting basis.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report the Egyptian branch's closing of accounts date; foreign head-office year-end is not controlling for Egyptian filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue: marine inspection, survey, hull/cargo claims investigation fees, consultancy and related income before deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All Egyptian-source survey and inspection fees, even where invoiced by the non-resident partner or via cross-border wire, must be declared; treaty allocation must be supported by an arm's length fee.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales and direct expenses: survey crew costs, marine survey vessel charter, appraisal subcontracting, claims laboratory costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Costs invoiced by the foreign parent or sister company are controlled expenditures; invoices must satisfy Egyptian VAT/ITA documentation and transfer pricing rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenses and allowable deductions (salaries, rents, depreciation, FRA licensing fees, insurance).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only expenses economically borne by the Egyptian activity with proper records are deductible; home-office allocations should be charged per the approved TP methodology.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable profit before prior-year loss relief.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Branch profit must include any Egyptian-source income booked offshore; a non-resident's real central management and control in Egypt creates Egyptian tax residence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Loss carryforward relief from prior years (5-year limitation).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Loss relief applies only for accumulated Egyptian reportable business losses; losses of the foreign head office are not deductible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax computation: taxable income multiplied by 22.5%; alternative estimated-profit methods do not apply to a licensed marine surveyor LLC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For non-residents without a PE, Egyptian-source service fees are subject to service WHT at source rather than CIT; with a PE/LLC, CIT at 22.5% applies to PE allocable profit and repatriated income is untaxed at source except for dividend WHT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits and prepayments: quarterly advance CIT, withholding tax credits, tax deductions under Law 72/2017.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credit is limited to the portion of foreign tax attributable to Egypt or, where branch profits are remitted, treaty foreign tax credit claims filed with the ETA.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balance due or refund; declaration and certification of accuracy.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Remitted profits must be declared in the distribution annex; the ETA may require the director/shareholder certification and board resolution for tax refunds.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of Form 12 carries a statutory fine of EGP 500 to EGP 2,000. Late payment of assessed CIT attracts an additional tax of 2% per month of the unpaid amount computed from the statutory deadline (no separate daily surcharge exists). Under-reported income or failure to submit TP documentation with the return may trigger penalties of 20% to 100% of the tax differential, plus documentary fines of up to EGP 1,000,000 under the Egyptian TP regulations.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax (WHT) on cash or in-kind profit distributions made by an Egyptian company, including distributions to non-resident shareholders, under Article 56(1) of Law No. 91/2005.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim a reduced DTA rate, the non-resident recipient must: (i) obtain an Egyptian tax residency certificate (TRC) or a home-tax authority residence certificate (legalized/apostilled where required, acceptable under the applicable DTA); (ii) submit the TRC plus a completed ETA treaty relief application and beneficial-ownership declaration to the Egyptian Tax Authority before or with the distribution; (iii) document the payer's branch or bank details; and (iv) apply on the ETA e-portal for either relief at source or a refundable WHT credit. The ETA generally applies the treaty only after TRC validation; TRCs are typically valid for 12 months and refund processing can take 6 to 12 months depending on ETA workload.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT of 20% applies to interest and royalties paid by Egyptian payers to non-residents. Under Egypt's DTAs, treaty WHT commonly covers interest at 0% to 15% (bank interest frequently exempt) and royalties at 5% to 15% depending on the treaty (for example, 10% under many OECD and bilateral investment treaties) where the recipient is the beneficial owner and the asset is not effectively connected to an Egyptian PE.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File and TP Disclosure Form required when aggregate related-party transactions in the Egyptian tax year exceed EGP 8,000,000; Master File and CbCR threshold: multinational group consolidated revenue of approximately EGP 4,000,000,000 (Egyptian documentation thresholds under ETA TP Regulations and Decree No. 415 of 2021).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt has no separate Caribbean-type ESR filing for standard marine surveyors; however, substance is enforced through: (a) the general anti-avoidance rule in Law 91/2005 allowing the ETA to disregard or recharacterize arrangements lacking genuine commercial purpose; (b) CFC rules applicable to Egyptian residents controlling low-tax offshore insurers or shell survey firms; (c) Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) licensing and fit-and-proper requirements, which require marine insurance surveyors to maintain a real office, maritime professional staff and actual forensic and damage inspection capacity; and (d) treaty benefits requiring the recipient to demonstrate substantive activity in the residence state. A desk-only shell with no real survey marine capability is prima facie challengeable.
